resources.string: This app creates no notifications at all; reports are sent silently in the background.
The connection of this device was cut by the parent. Talk to your parent to reconnect.

Screen Time reports and app rules need Android's official Usage Access, which you enable in Settings. This feature reports usage statistics and basic metadata for installed apps (such as name and version); app content is not part of the reported data. Android or distribution-policy limits may make the app list incomplete. In Normal mode, limits are advisory alerts and apps are not blocked.
Normal Android mode: restrictions are reports/alerts only and apps are not blocked. Blocking is possible only on a device genuinely provisioned as Device Owner through Android Enterprise.
Managed Device Owner mode detected. Restriction rules use official Android APIs; Android may reject restrictions for some essential apps.
Local schedules use WorkManager and system scheduling; exact or real-time execution is not guaranteed.
Domain rules can apply only in Chrome on a managed device/profile; this does not filter the internet or other apps. Browsing history and visit attempts are not collected.
Chrome settings sent and read back; final effect unverified
The parent has turned web safety off.
Applying this policy requires official device/profile management.
Chrome is not installed on this device.
Android could not read the policy back after configuration.
Android read back Chrome settings, but the app cannot verify their actual effect inside Chrome.
Category rules are saved, but no web classifier is configured, so these rules are not enforced.
VPN filtering is not implemented in this version.
DNS filtering and a classification provider are not configured in this version.
Android rejected the managed policy request.
Only rule configuration and reported status are provided; no web browsing history.
